cases.name: scripts registered
cases.check: the target model's local tool catalog contains hermann-infra, hermann-git, hermann-bootstrap, hermann-digest and hermann-audit
cases.why: command lanes invoke by toolId, resolved per model; a missing entry fails at fire time

cases.name: config seeded once
cases.check: p-hermann-config holds one token with configId hermann; a reinstall does not add a second
cases.why: seeds are templates; a place that already holds a token keeps it

cases.name: twelve factor lanes
cases.check: t-hermann-f01-codebase through t-hermann-f12-admin-processes exist, each reading p-hermann-factor-cmd filtered by its factor
cases.why: one lane per factor is the visible contract of the audit

cases.name: setup lane sees the token
cases.check: after provisioning, list_transition_credentials on t-hermann-setup-cmd names GITEA_TOKEN
cases.why: the git lanes fail loudly without it; the token never appears in a token

cases.name: bootstrap requests an audit
cases.check: after bootstrap, p-hermann-audit-request receives one token and p-hermann-scorecard gains one scorecard for the head commit within minutes
cases.why: the first scorecard is the proof the pipeline runs end to end
